title: The Education Of A Value Investor

questions.q: What did Guy Spier pay $650,100 for?
questions.why: He paid that amount for a lunch with Buffett.

questions.q: What moral dilemma did Spier face at his investment bank?
questions.why: The bank made deals seem more profitable than they were.

questions.q: What habit did Spier adopt to strengthen professional relationships?
questions.why: He wrote thank‑you cards to people who helped him.

questions.q: Why do value investors view financial crises as opportunities?
questions.why: Crises create panic selling, putting valuable companies on sale.

questions.q: What principle did Spier learn about investing time?
a: Invest time in people as you invest money
questions.why: He learned a great investor also invests time in people.
